title: Baseline Model & Data Pipeline
excerpt: Implemented the baseline model and built the data ingestion pipeline. First experiments are running.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Week 2 focused on moving from theory to code. The baseline model is now running end-to-end, and the data pipeline can handle the full dataset without errors.

sections.heading: Completed
items: Implemented baseline model architecture based on the Week 1 literature review
Built and validated the data ingestion and preprocessing pipeline
Ran first set of training experiments — loss curves look stable
Set up experiment tracking with output logging

sections.heading: Observations
sections.body: The baseline is performing roughly in line with the numbers reported in prior work, which is a good sign the pipeline is correct. Main bottleneck right now is preprocessing speed — may parallelize that next week.

sections.heading: Next Steps
items: Profile and optimize the data pipeline
Run ablation experiments on the baseline

title: Project Kickoff & Literature Review
excerpt: Established the project framework, set up the development environment, and completed the initial literature review.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Week 1 marked the start of Summer Project 2026. The focus was on setting a solid foundation — getting the environment in shape and surveying the existing literature before writing any code.

sections.heading: Completed
items: Set up project repository, environment, and tooling
Reviewed 8 papers covering the core problem space
Identified the 3 most relevant prior works to build on
Drafted the initial project proposal and research questions
Discussed scope with advisor and confirmed direction

sections.heading: Key Takeaways from Literature
sections.body: The most recent approaches share a common weakness: they don't generalize well across domains. This gap is what this project aims to address. The baseline I'll implement comes from the current state of the art on the benchmark I'll use.

sections.heading: Next Steps
items: Set up the training and evaluation loop
